pr_metadata.title: fix: remove keycloak_auth cookie requirement for webhook secrets endpoint
pr_metadata.description:
## Summary of PR

V1 conversations started from the Slack integration were failing to retrieve GitHub tokens because the `/api/v1/webhooks/secrets` endpoint requires authentication, but the middleware was rejecting requests without a `keycloak_auth` cookie.

**Root cause:** The `/api/v1/webhooks/secrets` endpoint uses `X-Access-Token` header for authentication (via JWT), but the middleware's `_check_tos` method only recognizes:
- `keycloak_auth` cookie
- `Authorization: Bearer ...` header  
- `X-Session-API-Key` header

Since `X-Access-Token` is not in this list, requests to the secrets endpoint from sandboxes were being rejected unless a cookie was also present. Browser-initiated conversations work because they have a cookie, but Slack-initiated conversations don't have a browser session.

**Fix:**
1. Add `/api/v1/webhooks/secrets` to the middleware's `ignore_paths` - This endpoint has its own JWT-based authentication via `X-Access-Token`, so middleware auth is redundant
2. Remove the `keycloak_auth_cookie` workaround from `LiveStatusAppConversationService` - This was added in #11814 as a workaround but is no longer needed
